topology_reasoning: The target is best described as a three-component structure with a central left stem and two detached S-bend-like output arms that diverge to top and bottom edges with tapered widths. The arm outputs separate from the stem and are not connected as one continuous route.
working_hypothesis: Central horizontal tapered stem plus two branch paths with width growth toward outputs; no loops or resonators.

iterations.change_made: First baseline with single-width stem and two single-width arms (paths only).

Reintroduced separate branch width segments and tuned right-end x placement.
Added segmented tapering for center stem and arms.
Extended stem and arm x-anchors to fill the 40 um footprint and rebalance branch widths/taper profile.
Set GDS writes to `with_metadata=False` and bound delta-length knob to one arm endpoint; geometry kept near Iter-5 baseline.
